title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 38
text:
83. LIPs should be told of the consequences of failing to file or serve their own witness
statements in advance of the hearing/trial (and not understanding that in consequence they
may not be able to give evidence).

84. LIPs may not understand that a witness statement is of little value without attendance of the
witness in support, and indeed may not be admitted at all.

85. If an LIP applies to adjourn to call a witness, bear in mind that they may genuinely not have
realised just how important the attendance of the witness is. If the application is refused, a
clear explanation should be given.
Adjournments

86. LIPs may not appreciate that they need permission for an adjournment if a hearing date
presents them with difficulties. They may believe they can simply say they are unable
to attend.
